title: Concept: Package that ships bundled dependencies
description: package.json declares a `bundleDependencies` list that vendors packages into the tarball, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `bundleDependencies` list that vendors packages into the tarball.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `bundleDependencies` list that vendors packages into the tarball.
